name: The agreement of the grammarians (ijmāʿ al-nuḥāt)
definition: The agreement of the grammarians of Basra and Kufa on a rule, which later grammarians take as a proof beside hearing and analogy.
body: Ibn Jinnī counts the agreement of 'the people of the two cities' as a proof, so long as it does not go against what was heard; al-Suyūṭī's al-Iqtirāḥ treats it as the third source of grammar after samāʿ and qiyās. In the commentaries 'by agreement' (bi-l-ittifāq, ijmāʿan) closes a question, while 'in the view of the majority' (ʿinda al-jumhūr) leaves it open.
